descByPlatform.flux: A cinematic horror portrait composition rendered at the highest level of hyper-realistic human character detail in a haunted gothic library setting. Shot with the immersive selfie perspective of a 35mm wide-angle lens with the camera arm extended from the central character toward the viewer, creating the classic handheld group selfie composition — but caught in a moment of genuine collective terror. Every character in the tightly packed group is rendered with full hyper-realistic skin, hair, fabric, and expression detail. The central man: stocky middle-aged build with practical oval glasses, a heavy winter jacket with a thick real fur hood trim in dark brown. His expression is maximum alarm — eyes stretched wide, mouth slightly open, his whole body torqued as his extended arm points urgently and emphatically behind the group. In the extreme left foreground beside him: a woman with short practical brown hair cut at the jaw, thick-framed reading glasses, wearing a well-worn warm orange-rust chunky knit sweater. Her expression is caught at the threshold between confused and properly scared, leaning forward. Right beside her: a tall woman with natural red-auburn hair wearing a dusty purple fit-and-flare dress, both hands clutching a thick leather-bound library book to her chest, her expression genuinely concerned and confused — something is very wrong. Visible in the mid-ground slightly behind the front group: a stocky man in practical blue-collar work clothing — dark work trousers, checked shirt — his posture alert and ready, scanning the space with controlled professional caution. Positioned in the right area of the background: a young man with clean neat blonde hair in a casual jacket, his expression controlled and serious in contrast to the others — someone trying to keep it together. The tallest figure behind the central man: a man with noticeably disheveled dark messy hair in a state of complete unrestrained terror, eyes wide, mouth open. Somewhere within the cluster: a medium-sized dog with fur raised along its back, ears fully alert, body frozen and facing the unseen threat. The gothic library environment: towering floor-to-ceiling shelving units filled with centuries of leather-bound volumes, elaborate carved stone column capitals, wall-mounted iron candlestick sconces with real flames, framed vintage maps and painted portraits on the stone walls. At the rear: a magnificent large pointed-arch gothic window through which absolutely cold blue-white moonlight enters in powerful directional shafts, creating volumetric light rays in the dusty air and casting long cold shadows across the back wall. This cold silvery moonlight is counteracted by the warm flickering orange-amber of the candle sconces — the two light sources creating extraordinary cinematic drama. The composition is tight and slightly claustrophobic — the characters fill the frame densely, the extended arm creates foreground immersion and the wide-angle slight distortion of the 35mm adds urgency. Hyper-realistic humans with subtle stylized quality, ultra-detailed cinematic horror atmosphere. No distortion, no extra limbs, correct anatomy, consistent faces throughout, no duplicate people. 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K resolution.
